category_title: Preschoolers with Autism and communication delays who exhibit physical aggression during activity transitions
minimal_context: Chris is playing with toys in the pre-kindergarten classroom and is instructed to clean up.
dialogue:
TUTOR: Chris, playtime is over. It is time to put the toys away and stop playing.

STUDENT: (Drops to the floor and speaks with poor articulation) N-no!

TUTOR: You need to get up off the floor and clean up.

STUDENT: (Elopes from the activity area, running away from the toys) No!

TUTOR: Chris, come back here right now and listen to me.

STUDENT: (Grabs an item from a nearby table, throws it across the classroom, and starts kicking) No!

options.A: Provide Chris with advance warnings before transitioning away from the toys.
options.B: Guide Chris through short practices focusing on breath and body awareness.
options.C: Help Chris reflect on the consequences of his actions and the emotions of others.
options.D: Prompt Chris to request a preferred item during the classroom activity.
